collection.title: Lamborghini Aventador 2011 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Lamborghini Aventador 2011 Onwards requires a 28" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 24" wiper blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the 19mm Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.

image.alt: Lamborghini Aventador 2011 to 2024 Windscreen Wiper Blades
